parameters.search: FixedIV0:D0=C0,Di=(Ci-Cprev)mod29; all runes retained and lexical endpoints unchanged. Frozen E083/E081 substitution solver on D and BOS/EOS word objective, no new starts/parameters. Per page search seed3303086+100*originalLP2number, reused identically in all of that page's nulls. No runes omitted; original lexical endpoints fixed. Full per-restart outputs retained.
parameters.selection: Maximum mean word score over46pages, stable page-order ties; freeze winner and all46 output hashes before any null draws.
parameters.null: Original C-space selected-page independent interior shuffles preserving first/last rune, exact counts, adjacent-equality count, fixed original segment ends. Random(null_seed+100*replicate), max100000 proposals; After shuffling C, compute D withIV0 and run full identical optimizer; D counts are not fixed.
parameters.inference: Plus-one p=(1+exceedances)/20, Bonferroni46. Minimum corrected p is1, coarse screening only. Zero exceedances requires separately preregistered larger calibration, not pooled adaptive sampling.
parameters.limits: E085 transports12 prior controls exactly without new optimizer searches. Unknown IV is fixed0, other IVs untested; capability does not prove the cipher. Source boundaries/page edges may not be plaintext word boundaries. Finite29-symbol bijection search, no exhaustive29! claim; no scope extrapolation to short pages.
